ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) base pixels to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pigmentation and edge markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of high-intensity pixels. Low-intensity clusters are mapped as follows: a series of 5-7 discrete circular blobs distributed across the central and lower-left regions; a concentrated dark region bordering the right side of the median notch; and continuous dark banding along the entire trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 70-degree convergence angle and a vertical pixel depth of approximately 1/8th the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits 14 distinct peaks; right lobe trailing edge exhibits 12 distinct peaks. Distal tips show extreme irregular jaggedness with pixel variances exceeding 20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the notch and sweeping upward towards the distal tips; left lobe displays a more acute upward terminal sweep compared to the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular dark-pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface, most prominently in the mid-left lobe and the immediate right of the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned dark linear streaks (rake marks) observed in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear abrasions on the left lobe and significant irregular erosion/pigmentation loss at the terminal tips, particularly the leftmost extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast dark 'teardrop' shaped spot located approximately midway between the notch and the left distal tip.
